backend/main.mo: Empty Motoko actor serving as the backend entry point with no implemented functionality.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting that the Footer component's first social media link (Facebook) should display 'Hasnain' as its visible label, with high confidence and linked to test REQ-12.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON-formatted summaries of key frontend source files describing the App, Footer, and index.html components of the Z Square Mall website.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind CSS stylesheet defining CSS custom properties for light and dark theme color tokens (background, foreground, primary, chart colors, sidebar, etc.) using oklch values.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point for the Z Square Mall SPA, including SEO meta tags, Google Fonts preconnect for Playfair Display and Inter, and a root div with the main TSX module script.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component that assembles the full single-page Z Square Mall website by rendering all section components (Navbar, Hero, About, ArchitecturalHighlights, StoresAndBrands, DiningAndEntertainment, VisitorServices, Timings, Contact, Footer) in order.
frontend/src/components/About.tsx: About section component displaying Z Square Mall's story, key highlights (architect, owner, year, location) with scroll-triggered animations and gold accent styling.
frontend/src/components/ArchitecturalHig: Section component showcasing Z Square Mall's architectural firsts in India (atrium design, post-tension technology, materials, travelators) along with structural specs, using scroll animations on a dark background.
frontend/src/components/Contact.tsx: Contact section displaying Z Square Mall's address, phone, and email details in styled cards with scroll-triggered animations and a two-column layout including a map area.
frontend/src/components/DiningAndEnterta: Tabbed dining and entertainment section listing food court, fine dining, sweet treats, cinema, and kids' zone options with per-category descriptions and items, rendered on a dark gradient background.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Renders the site footer with a brand logo, description, social media links (Facebook, Instagram, X), and navigation links with smooth-scroll behavior.
frontend/src/components/Hero.tsx: Full-screen hero section for Z Square Mall featuring animated stat counters (area, brands, parking), decorative geometric elements, and a scroll-to-about chevron button.
frontend/src/components/Navbar.tsx: Fixed top navigation bar with scroll-aware background blur, active section highlighting, smooth-scroll links, and a responsive mobile hamburger menu.
Displays a filterable grid of 27 mall brands organized into categories (Department Stores, Fashion, Electronics, etc.) with color-coded category badges and floor information.
frontend/src/components/Timings.tsx: Shows mall operating hours for Shops, Food Court, and INOX Cinemas in animated cards with weekday/weekend breakdowns, using scroll-triggered visibility transitions.
React component rendering a 'Visitor Facilities' section with a grid of 8 service cards (parking, WiFi, wheelchairs, etc.) and additional service badges, using scroll-based fade-in animation.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Custom hook that creates and caches an ICP backend actor (authenticated or anonymous) using React Query, and invalidates dependent queries whenever the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides an InternetIdentityProvider and useInternetIdentity hook for managing DFINITY Internet Identity authentication state, including login, logout, and identity persistence via AuthClient.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Placeholder module with no exports, indicating no backend queries are needed for this static website.
frontend/src/hooks/useScrollAnimation.ts: Custom hook that uses IntersectionObserver to track when a referenced element enters the viewport, returning a visibility boolean for triggering CSS animations.
frontend/src/index.css: Global stylesheet defining the Z Square Mall brand palette (navy/gold/cream) as CSS custom properties, Tailwind base/component/utility layers, and reusable utility classes for animations, gradients, and typography.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that mounts the React app wrapped with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider into the DOM root.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration extending the default theme with brand-specific fonts (Playfair Display, Inter), oklch-based color tokens (navy, gold, cream), custom border radii, and box shadows, plus typography and animation plugins.
project_state.json: Project state manifest describing the Z Square Mall single-page React website's architecture, implemented features, brand palette, and known issues at schema version 1.0.0.
